attempts.summary: Configured OPNsense (node1, FreeBSD) with the os-haproxy plugin to load-balance TCP port 80 on its address 10.100.223.10 (round-robin) across node2 and node3, which each run a persistent systemd-managed Python HTTP server on port 8080 identifying their own hostname. Verified from node4 that repeated requests to node1:80 return alternating responses from node2 and node3. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot identity on each and re-verifying service health and end-to-end load balancing after each restart.
